title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Further Improving the Work of People's Tribunals in 2009
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Further Improving the Work of People's Tribunals in 2009

Fa [2009] No. 94

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Since the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Central Committee has issued a series of important policies to advance rural reform and development. To fully implement the Central Committee's strategic decisions and arrangements, fully leverage the functions of people's tribunals, and provide strong judicial guarantees and legal services for the overall work of agriculture and rural areas, the following notice is hereby given on matters concerning further improvement of the work of people's tribunals in 2009:

I. Deeply Understand the Essence of the Central Committee's Policies and Lay a Solid Ideological Foundation for the Work of People's Tribunals

The "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Promoting Rural Reform and Development" adopted at the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, from the perspective of the overall layout of the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics and the strategic overall situation of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, formulated an action plan for promoting rural reform and development under the new situation. To improve agricultural and rural work in 2009, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council pointed out in Document No. 1 of 2009 of the Central Committee (Zhongfa [2009] No. 1) that: the greatest potential for expanding domestic demand lies in rural areas; the basic support for achieving stable and relatively fast economic development lies in agriculture; and the key and difficult point for ensuring and improving people's livelihoods lies in farmers. People's courts at all levels must earnestly study and deeply understand the essence of the above Central Committee policies, and fully recognize the important position of agricultural and rural work in the overall work of the Party and the state. Ninety-five percent of China's people's tribunals are located in rural areas. People's courts at all levels should regard improving the work of people's tribunals as an important part of the people's courts' in-depth study and practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development, and as an important means of implementing the Central Committee's strategic decisions. They must grasp and implement this work well, and strive for new achievements and new results.

II. Earnestly Implement the Requirements of Relevant Documents of the Supreme People's Court and Comprehensively Improve the Quality and Level of Work of People's Tribunals

To effectively implement the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Supreme People's Court formulated and issued the "Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees and Legal Services for Promoting Rural Reform and Development." This important judicial policy document provides a comprehensive deployment in terms of: fully leveraging the trial function to ensure the vigorous advancement of rural reform and innovation and the further strengthening of rural institutional construction; strengthening the protection of modern agriculture to enhance the comprehensive agricultural production capacity; actively and steadily carrying out work to promote comprehensive social progress in rural areas through judicial means; and continuing to strengthen the implementation of institutional measures to ensure the continuous improvement of the level of judicial guarantees and legal services. The year 2009 marks the 60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, and is a key year for promoting the smooth realization of the "Eleventh Five-Year Plan," comprehensively responding to the international financial crisis, and achieving stable and relatively fast economic and social development. To better serve the scientific development of the economy and society and better achieve the scientific development of the people's courts themselves, the Supreme People's Court clearly stated in the "Key Work Points of People's Courts for 2009": to deeply study and practice the Scientific Outlook on Development, and strive to practice the guiding ideology of "three supremacies"; to focus on the overall work of the Party and the state and provide strong judicial guarantees for stable and relatively fast economic development; to fully leverage the trial function to ensure national security and social stability; to pay close attention to people's livelihoods and effectively address difficult and hot issues concerning the interests of the masses in the work of the people's courts; to strengthen anti-corruption and integrity building and enhance judicial credibility. Whether the work of people's tribunals can reach a new level and achieve new progress in 2009 depends on the earnest implementation of the above deployments and requirements. People's courts at all levels should focus on implementing and executing the above-mentioned documents of the Supreme People's Court, plan and carry out the work of people's tribunals in 2009 well, comprehensively improve the quality and level of work of people's tribunals, and make positive contributions to the overall work of the Party and the state.

III. Aiming at Guaranteeing Growth, Create Favorable Conditions for Strengthening Modern Agriculture and Promoting Stable Development of Agricultural Production

(1) Firmly establish and continuously strengthen the strictest awareness of farmland protection, and increase judicial sanctions against acts that damage or encroach on farmland in accordance with the law. For acts of damaging or encroaching on farmland discovered during case trials, timely measures shall be taken in accordance with the law to correct them, ensuring the realization of the farmland protection goal of "use control, economical use, and strict management."

(2) Focus on properly adjudicating dispute cases involving various stages of production, processing, packaging, transportation, and sale of agricultural production materials and agricultural products, and balance the rights and obligations of the parties involved in the circulation of agricultural production materials and agricultural products. Pay attention to equally maintaining the order of production factor allocation and transaction in agricultural product production and protecting the legitimate rights and interests of rural consumers, effectively implement the legal principle of equal protection, and on the basis of legally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the parties, promote the healthy development of the production of agricultural production materials and agricultural products.

(3) Further strengthen the trial and enforcement work of dispute cases involving agricultural infrastructure construction projects, and legally protect the interests of investors in agricultural infrastructure construction projects. Pay attention to improving the efficiency of trial work to avoid affecting the smooth progress of construction projects due to case trials. Aiming at protecting the safety of agricultural infrastructure projects, increase judicial sanctions against acts that damage agricultural infrastructure, especially those focusing on farmland water conservancy.

(4) Legally protect the legitimate rights and interests of emerging rural market entities such as farmers' cooperative organizations, and improve the quality and level of trial work concerning such new types of cases. Trial work shall be carried out in accordance with the principle of being conducive to improving the intensification and organization of the agricultural market, provide high-quality and efficient judicial guarantees and legal services for the development of the collective economy and the accelerated development of specialized farmers' cooperatives, and promote innovation in the agricultural operation system and mechanism and the transformation of agricultural operation methods.

IV. Taking Guaranteeing People's Livelihoods as the Key, Lay a Solid Foundation for Effectively Protecting the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Farmers and Achieving the Happiness and Well-being of Farmers

(1) Properly handle dispute cases concerning rural land contracting, and protect the functions of the right to land contractual management legally enjoyed by farmers. Implement the rights of possession, use, and usufruct of contracted land legally enjoyed by farmers, and provide all-round judicial protection. Attach great importance to promptly correcting and stopping illegal acts that infringe upon the rights and interests of rural migrant workers and business people in terms of land contractual management, and effectively avoid social risks arising from their becoming landless farmers.

(2) Prudently handle dispute cases concerning the expropriation of rural collective land and the distribution of land compensation fees, and promptly resolve conflicts that may escalate. For group incidents arising therefrom, proactively seek the leadership, cooperation, and support of Party committees, governments, and people's congresses, and properly resolve disputes in ways that farmers can understand and accept. In the trial of cases, pay attention to strengthening the protection of vulnerable groups, and maximize the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of farmers, especially women and children.

(3) Accurately understand and implement the relevant provisions of laws, administrative regulations, and judicial interpretations, and properly handle the relationship between protecting the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers and the healthy development of enterprises. In the process of adjudicating cases involving the protection of migrant workers' rights, the protection of migrant workers' rights and the healthy development of enterprise production shall not be opposed. While protecting the immediate interests of migrant workers, also focus on safeguarding their long-term and fundamental interests. While legally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers, strive to promote the healthy development of enterprise production. In terms of labor conditions, production safety, labor remuneration, and work-related injury, medical, and pension insurance, guide and establish a social concept of equality between urban and rural areas, and make active efforts to establish a unified urban and rural human resources market and promote the integration of urban and rural economic and social development.

(4) When adjudicating dispute cases arising from migrant workers returning to their hometowns to start businesses, increase the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of returning migrant worker entrepreneurs. Creating favorable conditions for migrant workers returning to their hometowns to start businesses is a key content of the current work of the people's courts concerning migrant workers, and is a crucial link in the work of people's tribunals in 2009. From the perspective of ensuring stable economic and social development, actively explore and steadily promote judicial protection work system and measures for the legitimate rights and interests of returning migrant worker entrepreneurs, and make positive contributions to the stable development of agriculture and the protection and improvement of people's livelihoods.

(5) For labor, debt, and contract disputes caused by issues such as economic interests and people's livelihoods, under the leadership of Party committees and with the support of governments, use methods such as mediation and reconciliation as much as possible, exhaustively seek the balance point of interests of all parties, and strive to achieve mutual benefit and win-win results. In the enforcement work of cases, from the perspective of being conducive to promoting the survival and development of enterprises, ensuring the livelihood of employees, and maintaining social harmony and stability, make every effort to eliminate economic and social risks caused by improper enforcement measures. Vigorously carry out activities to concentrate on clearing up backlog enforcement cases, and explore the establishment of a long-term enforcement mechanism with coordination and organization by the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Party Committee, the people's court as the lead, linkage of relevant departments, and participation of all sectors of society.

V. Focusing on Maintaining Stability, Create a Harmonious and Stable Social Environment for the Vigorous Advancement of Rural Reform and Innovation and the Further Strengthening of Rural Institutional Construction

(1) In accordance with the requirements of the Supreme People's Court's "Decision on Comprehensively Strengthening the Work of People's Tribunals," adhere to the basic requirements of "facing the countryside, facing the grassroots, and facing the masses" in carrying out work. Implement the principle of classified guidance, and vigorously carry out circuit trials according to local conditions. Aiming at maintaining stability, fully leverage the advantages of people's tribunals in facing the countryside and being close to the masses, so that each people's tribunal becomes a strong fortress for maintaining harmony and stability in rural society.

(2) Fully protect the various functions of the right to land contractual management in accordance with the law, and ensure the stability and long-term unchanged nature of land contractual relations. The right to land contractual management is the core of farmers' various rights and interests, and is the key to stabilizing and improving the basic rural operation system. Deeply understand the significance of protecting the various functions of the right to land contractual management, focus on protecting farmers' various rights and interests in land contracting, strengthen the adjudication of rural land contract dispute cases, and strive to resolve the basic contradictions affecting the stability of rural society.

(3) Strictly implement laws and national policies, and regulate and protect the transfer of land contractual management rights. Promoting the establishment and improvement of the market for the transfer of land contractual management rights is an important measure proposed by the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee to vigorously promote rural reform and innovation. In accordance with the relevant requirements of the "Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees and Legal Services for Promoting Rural Reform and Development," and aiming at promoting the establishment and improvement of the transfer market and protecting farmers' right to land contractual management, properly adjudicate dispute cases related to subcontracting, leasing, exchange, and equity investment of contracted land. Promote transfer through regulation and protection, and shall not unilaterally emphasize promoting transfer while neglecting or even damaging farmers' right to land contractual management.

(4) Earnestly implement the judicial principle of "mediation first, combination of mediation and adjudication," and fully leverage the important role of judicial mediation in building a harmonious socialist society and maintaining social stability. Timely summarize mediation experience, strive to improve the quality and level of mediation work, actively expand the fields and methods of mediation work, maximize the resolution of case disputes through judicial mediation, promote the coordination of litigation relationships between parties, and the order of judicial service relationships between parties and the people's court, and create a harmonious and stable social atmosphere.

(5) Strive to achieve the organic unity of the legal effect, social effect, and political effect of law enforcement and case handling, and shall not induce unstable factors due to trial and enforcement work. The legal effect, social effect, and political effect are an organic whole. The trial and enforcement work of people's tribunals shall be carried out with the standard of achieving the organic unity of the legal effect, social effect, and political effect. Special attention shall be paid to correcting the erroneous understanding and practice of separating the three effects and unilaterally emphasizing the legal effect while ignoring the social effect and political effect, to ensure that law enforcement and case handling achieve good results.

(6) Actively coordinate the cooperation and connection between various means of conflict resolution, and promote the continuous improvement of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Strive to improve the level of guidance to people's mediation organizations, realize innovation in means and methods, and promote the steady improvement of people's mediation effectiveness. Pay attention to linkage and collaboration with grassroots governments, villagers' self-governing organizations, and other diversified dispute resolution entities, build a full coverage network for dispute resolution, strive to resolve conflicts before litigation, nip them in the bud, and promote harmony and tranquility in rural society.

(7) Earnestly do a good job in handling rural-related petition work, and strive to fundamentally prevent and reduce the occurrence of petition cases related to litigation. Fully support and actively participate in the mechanism for protecting farmers' rights led by Party committees and governments, explore the establishment of a petition case termination mechanism under the leadership of Party committees, and work with relevant departments to improve the relief fund system for petitioners. Strengthen source governance, implement the system of separating petitions from litigation, and improve the working mechanism for receiving, diverting, and handling petition cases.

(8) Effectively explore new ways to combine judicial specialization and popularization, and attempt to establish a judicial assistance network. In accordance with the relevant requirements of the "Key Work Points of People's Courts for 2009," fully leverage the role of judicial assistants and the judicial assistance network, timely understand rural social conditions and public opinion, resolve conflicts and disputes, and take multiple measures to maintain harmony and stability in rural society.

VI. Proactively and Actively Carry Out Legal Services, Maximally Promote the Rule of Law and Comprehensive Progress in Rural Society

(1) Correct the incorrect understanding that mechanically understands judicial passivity, start from the perspective of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, and actively carry out legal services. Innovate the forms and approaches of legal services, change from passivity to activity, and vigorously improve the quality and level of legal services. Through various effective forms such as trial activities, closely link legal education with the specific conditions of agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, continuously improve the concept and level of the rule of law in rural society, build people's tribunals into important positions and platforms for connecting with the vast number of farmers and meeting their judicial service needs, and fully leverage the important role of people's tribunals in promoting the rule of law in rural society.

(2) Attach great importance to and effectively leverage the guiding role of judicial judgments on rural social morality and value orientation, promote the construction of a social credit system, and promote socialist moral concepts. Pay attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of parties who value contracts and keep promises, and fully leverage the unique role of trial work in commending trustworthiness and compliance with agreements. Through judicial means, advocate socialist moral norms that uphold science, honesty and law-abiding, resist superstition, and transform social traditions, and promote the formation of a social atmosphere in rural areas featuring equality between men and women, respect for the elderly and love for the young, family harmony, neighborly harmony, prosperity through hard work, and mutual assistance.

VII. Earnestly Implement the "Five Prohibitions" Provisions, Strengthen Anti-Corruption and Integrity Building, and Enhance Judicial Credibility

On January 8, the Supreme People's Court formally issued the "Provisions on the 'Five Prohibitions,'" requiring that judicial personnel of the people's courts are prohibited from: accepting invitations to dinner or gifts from parties to cases and related persons; engaging in improper dealings with lawyers in violation of regulations; interfering in cases handled by others; engaging in fraud or malpractice in activities such as entrusted evaluation and auction; and disclosing trial work secrets. In building the team of people's tribunals, people's courts at all levels shall focus on earnestly implementing the "Five Prohibitions" provisions, establish and strictly implement anti-corruption and integrity rules and regulations. Deeply carry out education on advanced models and warning education, especially using cases of violations of law and discipline that occur around them to educate the vast number of judicial officers. For judicial officers who violate the "Five Prohibitions" provisions and are unsuitable to continue engaging in trial or enforcement work, they shall be resolutely transferred from their posts; if the circumstances are serious, they shall be resolutely dealt with according to law and discipline. Orders must be obeyed and prohibitions must be strictly enforced to effectively prevent the occurrence of corruption. Through a clean and honest judicial image and fair and efficient judicial style, continuously enhance the judicial credibility of people's tribunals in the vast rural areas.

The year 2009 is an extremely critical year for the people's courts, especially people's tribunals. People's courts at all levels must further enhance their awareness of potential dangers, firmly establish and implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, always adhere to the important guiding ideology of the "three supremacies," and on the basis of the work in 2008, with a proactive attitude, earnestly grasp the work of people's tribunals. People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the requirements of this notice, timely research and formulate targeted work plans and implementation opinions that are suitable for local realities. For new situations and problems discovered in the work of local people's tribunals, attention shall be paid to earnestly researching and analyzing the causes and countermeasures, and when necessary, timely report them level by level.

It is hereby notified.

February 11, 2009
